notes: 25 Sept 2026: David Ornstein/The Athletic reported City found guilty on 114 of 115 charges. 29 Sept: the Premier League issued a statement on the independent commission's decision. 1 Oct (7pm): City lodged an appeal against the commission's opinion; per ESPN, Sky Sports, Euronews, CBS Sports, Al Jazeera and the Premier League's own 2 Oct statement, City were found guilty of all but one of the charges (all financial-rules charges for 2009-10 to 2017-18 and three of four cooperation charges), the appeal goes to an independent three-member Appeal Board, a hearing is expected within 12 weeks and a decision is due within 30 days of the hearing ending. Sanction is to be decided separately. Keep status_tag 'FOUND (reported)' until the commission's written opinion is confirmed public, then retag 'FOUND (published decision)' and link it. The Premier League statement pages (premierleague.com/en/news/4727779 and /4729207) could not be opened from the research environment; wording is taken from coverage. 12-week window end (24 Dec 2026) is computed as 1 Oct + 84 days.
appeal_detail: City lodged an appeal against the commission's findings on 1 October 2026 (per the club and the Premier League, as reported). An independent three-member Appeal Board will hear it; the hearing is expected within 12 weeks and stays private until publication of the outcome is permitted. Sanction is still to be decided at a separate hearing.
